steps.content:
5:20 p.m., August 23, N.F. 113
Eastside, Banyan Medical College First Affiliated Hospital
Special Ward
Inspector Dole stays behind to accompany Christina. He says he'll wait for her to recover in the hospital.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: It's not a big deal, I'll prove it to you.
In front of Christina's hospital bed, Inspector Dole awkwardly cuts an apple. He's not good at taking care of people. He cuts pieces of different sizes, and almost cuts his hand.
The girl stares blankly without any reaction. In just a few days, she's lost a lot of weight, and her once sparkling eyes have dulled.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: MBCC has agreed, no matter what, they will not detain you until you've recovered from your injuries. In the meantime, the investigation team will prepare explanatory materials for you to prove your stability. Your uncle at FAC is also making connections everywhere.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: I don't know who exactly gave this order, but it's okay, we all know you're a good kid. You...
His words are cut off as his work phone vibrates. After Dole picks it up and whispers a few words, he frowns and stands up.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: I got work to do, so I'll get going. Eat something, take care of yourself first.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Inspector.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Hmm? What's up? Do you need something?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Does justice really exist?

Dole's eyes turn red. He roughly cuts the apple into the plate, sticks a toothpick in it, and places it in Christina' hand. He turns around to leave the ward but stops at the doorway, slamming his fist against the door frame.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Don't give up, Chris. You've always been advocating justice for others, now when it's your turn to need it, we'll give it back to you.
He steps out of the ward, the door is immediately locked. Christina is now in a semi-house arrest state, she sits blankly in the ward, staring out the window.
The sun sets, and night falls.

She gets out of bed, pulls out the hidden roll of bandages, ties one end around her waist and the other to the head of the bed. She checks the length, then checks the eaves and pipes outside the window where she can land.

She then turns and walks into the bathroom, picks up the fruit knife left by Dole, wipes it with the stashed alcohol, and makes a shallow cut behind her ear to remove the tracker. When she comes out, she grabs the top of the infusion stand, breaks it to a convenient length, and tucks it into her waist.
Before leaving, she notices the unsightly cut, yellowed apple on the plate. She picks up a piece to eat but then puts it back down.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Does it exist...
She rubs her red eyes and rolls out.
Half an hour later, alarms ring throughout the hospital, quickly spreading to half of Eastside.

01:24, August 24th, N.F. 113
The house of Christina and Mireya
A rough knock on the door wakes Mireya. She irritably sits up in her wheelchair, opens the door, and is met with a face she never expected to see.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Are you Christina's sister, Mireya?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Your sister, as a Sinner, has fallen below the safety and obedience thresholds and has been rated as A-Class. Immediate detainment is necessary.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Move aside! We need to conduct a thorough search!

Expressionless, Mireya steps aside and watches as they rummage through her things with a strange device. After a while, she follows them into the room and takes out a large stack of handwritten letters from Christina's drawer.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: Don't bother, she and I aren't biological sisters and don't get along. She wouldn't come here.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: Here, these are a few of the idiots she's helped. If anyone is going to harbor her, it will be one of these people.
The sheriff takes the letters from her hand with a puzzled look, opens a few, and starts to laugh mockingly. He nods at Mireya.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: You've done well in exposing the dangerous Sinner. You surely are an advocate for justice, citizen. Well done.
Upon hearing the word "justice," the already gloomy girl furrows her brows, revealing a disgusted expression.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: Go catch her already, don't let that Sinner escape. It's raining her most hated Blue Rain outside, she wouldn't dare to stay out there, hurry up.

02:03, August 24th, N.F. 113
FAC's Fifth Public Cemetery

Christina stands alone among the gravestones, the first place she thought of hiding, but there is no shelter from the rain. The Blue Rain soaks her completely, the Mania reaction burning her body and consciousness.
She vaguely hears voices, but she has no strength left to run. She turns her head and sees a figure approaching her, shouting something harshly, but Christina can no longer hear clearly.
It isn't until the person rushes up and grabs her hand that she recognizes the unmistakable figure of her sister in a wheelchair.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: What the hell are you doing here?!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Mireya? How did you...
Mireya quickly pulls a black raincoat over Christina's head, shielding her from the Blue Rain.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: They've already found our home, that list won't stall them for long. I don't know if they are coming, or if they've tracked me.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: What are you going to do next? How do you plan to escape from the hunt?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Escape...? No...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: There's more to this, I need to investigate... I need to find... the truth...

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: ...What happened?
Without waiting for a response, Mireya makes a disgusted face, shoving something into Christina's arms.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: Is it that woman again? I told you she's definitely trouble, but you keep fooling yourself.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: You've been on the run with her for so long, you should have seen it clearly by now. Is facing the truth that hard for you, detective?!

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: Sigh, forget it. Given the situation, you must have your own plans. Anyway, I can't stop you.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: Here's your stuff. You are in the police academy, cracked cases; all of this wasn't taught to you hand in hand by her. Without her, you're still a detective, don't act like a waste.

steps.speaker: Mireya
steps.content: Think about how you were when you first came to my house. You've managed to walk out from there, now pull yourself together!
Holding the stuff Mireya had given her, which included her spare cane, detective tools, and so on, Christina lifts her head and pulls the hood of the raincoat over her head.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Wrong answer. You should still seek the truth, capture the criminal, and prevent her from hurting anyone else. You're a detective, after all.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I'm off then. Thank you for coming for me.

04:21, August 24th, N.F. 113
Eastside Public Security Bureau Special Office
In a secret cell in Zone W, the Garden Assassin Thistle, who was in a coma, is awakened by the alarm.

steps.speaker: Alert
steps.content: Intrusion warning, intrusion warning. Zone E-2 has been breached, detainees have escaped, intrusion warning...

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: ...E-2... That's not my area...

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Right... She couldn't possibly still...
As she was thinking, the wall was suddenly smashed open. Thistle's eyes widened, she didn't expect any of her Garden partners to act so unruly. The person who stormed in surprised her even more.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Found you.

Without saying another word, Christina swings her cane to break the restraints on Thistle's limbs. The sophisticated lock was unlocked instantly in the face of the detective's violence. Christina grabs Thistle and rushes out.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Let me go! What are you trying to do?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Take me to the Garden, now!

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Go to hell, how could I do that a...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: In the past 5 days, news of Coquelic's impending death has been all over the place. Don't be so scared, it's probably a lie to trick you, haven't you been fooled like this before?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I just saw those HUSH squads leaving fully armed, if you know the way, hurry up and take shortcuts back.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: If you don't act now, your home will be gone!
Startled by this, Thistle panics, grabs Christina's wrist, dodges the sheriffs blocking the way, and rushes towards the end of the corridor.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Smash the wall!
The violent detective swings her cane and creates a large hole in the concrete wall. To her surprise, the assassin pulls her and jumps out—this is a height of several stories!

Amid the sound of the plummeting wind, the assassin swiftly cuts a shallow wound into her palm. The small injury immediately splits open into a willow leaf-shaped scar, its center glowing like a pupil... The traces of Mania rapidly spread along its edges.

Suddenly, before their fall, a pitch-black circular hole abruptly opens in mid-air. The two dive headfirst into it. Christina finally lets out a cry, only to find that the sounds around her have abruptly changed.
The hustle and bustle of DisCity is completely cut off. She finds herself in a dark, dome-like space. It's silent, gloomy... as if cut off from the world.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...What kind of power is this? Where am I?

Thistle doesn't answer her. Instead, she immediately gets up, pulls Christina away, and vigilantly turns back to stare at the solid black circle where they originally were, a flame-like blade forming in her palm.

First, a string of bullets is fired upwards from below. After a while, something the size of a head barely reveals half of itself from the black hole. Thistle roars and thrusts the flame blade down, pushing the invader back before it can fully emerge.

At the same time, the black circle quickly contracts and completely disappears, as if it had never appeared on this ground. Thistle then falls backward, panting heavily, as if everything has finally come to an end.
Christina looks around and spots a secluded building in the distance. There are lights on in the building, yet it's very quiet, an omen she can't quite decipher.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: ...Quick... return to the Garden...

04:30, August 24, N.F. 113
Spatial Sorcery, ??

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: This is... the last base. "Registered" members of the Garden can open the <color=#fb9259>entrance</color>, but it takes a long time to close once it's open, like what just happened.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: Thank goodness they're a bunch of idiots... If they had thrown a locator in here, I would have...
Christina silently supports Thistle, the two of them barely making up a whole, healthy person. The Sinners help each other towards the distant building.

The symbol on Thistle's palm when she opened the entrance is familiar. It's the same symbol that was on the Mania bombs in the recent FAC kidnapping incident, the symbol of the Underground Puppets. Shalom said it was the symbol of the most evil power in Dis.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Is this the Garden's power?

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: No. The Mentor said it's a reward... the reward for the last commission.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: She's finally going to have a Garden that won't be disturbed by anyone.
In other words, a shelter given to them by the Underground. Was that spatial technology just now?
Thinking about these things, the two approach the quiet building. As they get closer, an ominous feeling suddenly arises, stopping all their conversation.
As they get closer, they're left dumbfounded.

Christina reacts in an instant, giving Thistle an anesthetic to stop her from having a breakdown. It's something she stole from the hospital. Christina used it to deal with the guards watching Thistle, and there's still some left.
Once you get used to being a detective, you learn quite a few tricks for doing bad things yourself too.
Christina moves the unconscious assassin to the side. She turns to face everything in front of her; her temples throb uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: C'mon, Chris... This is the primary crime scene... You have to investigate the truth.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You must... prove it... yourself...

04:35, August 24, N.F. 113
Crime scene of the "Garden" incident
